agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in boltons/formatutils.py: infer_positional_format_args had `group[2:]` instead of `group[1:]` when reconstructing anonymous positional format fields, which discarded the trailing special character (one of `:!.[}`) and produced malformed format strings (e.g. '{0' instead of '{0}'). This caused ValueError: unexpected '{' in field name downstream in tokenize_format_str and related functions. Changed group[2:] to group[1:]. Verified infer_positional_format_args, tokenize_format_str, and get_format_args all now work correctly on representative inputs including the function's own doctest example.
